text: Where did Wi-Fi's rate improvements from 2 Mb/s to 46 Gb/s come from?
choices: Wider channels, denser modulation, more spatial streams, and less overhead — only spatial streams being a fundamentally new physical idea
explanation: Wider channels and denser modulation are Shannon's curve applied; less overhead is protocol engineering. MIMO is the genuinely new idea, and it is not on Shannon's single-channel curve at all because each stream is effectively a separate channel.
